Installation, Commissioning and Integration of PTZ & CCTV Cameras · The successful bidder shall be responsible for the complete installation, commissioning, testing and integr ation of all PTZ and CCTV cameras at the designated locations as specified by the Department. The bidder shall provide all necessary accessories, mounting brackets, connectors, cables, conduits, power supply arr angements and other installation materials required for proper functioning of the system. · The installation shall be carried out by qualified and experienced technical personnel of the bidder. The bi dder shall ensure proper positioning, alignment, focusing and configuration of PTZ and CCTV cameras, incl uding integration with the existing/required Network Video Recorder (NVR), monitoring system and other a ssociated equipment, wherever applicable. · The bidder shall ensure that all cameras are fully operational and provide the required video quality and c overage after installation. Any additional minor installation material required for successful commissioning shall be provided by the bidder at no extra cost to the Department. · The bidder shall also provide demonstration and basic operational training to the nominated personnel aft er successful installation and commissioning. 1. Specification of Camera Imaging & Sensor

Sensor: 24.2 MP full-frame CMOS sensor Processor: DIGIC X ISO Range: 100–102,400 for stills (expandable to 50–204,800); 100–25,600 for video Shutter Speed: Mechanical up to 1/8000 sec; Electronic up to 1/16000 sec Autofocus & Performance AF System: Dual Pixel CMOS AF II Subject Detection: Humans, animals (dogs, cats, birds, horses), and vehicles (cars, bikes, aircraft, trains) Continuous Shooting: Up to 40 fps with electronic shutter; up to 12 fps with mechanical shutter Video Capabilities Internal Recording: Uncropped 4K at up to 60p (oversampled from 6K) External RAW: 6K at 60p 10-bit RAW via HDMI (with compatible recorder like Atomos Ninja V+) Webcam Support: UVC/UAC plug-and-play via USB without extra drivers Design & Connectivity Viewfinder: 0.5-inch OLED with 3.69 million dots Rear Screen: 3.0-inch vari-angle touch LCD with 1.62 million dots Storage Slots: Dual UHS-II SD card slots Battery Type: LP-E6NH (compatible with LP-E6N and LP-E6) Dimensions: 138.4 × 98.4 × 88.4 mm Weight: Approx. 670 g (with battery and card 2. Specification of PTZ Camera 5MP WDR 45x IR Network PTZ Camera- 300 Mtr. • 1/2.8” 5MP PS CMOS Image sensor (0.9071 centimeter) • Max. 5MP (2960 × 1668)@1–25fps • Powerful 45x Optical and 16x Digital zoom • AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG • Support Triple Stream • WDR(120dB), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Day/Night(ICR), ROI, Defog, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC • Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern • Support Starlight Technology • IR Range of 300 Mtr. • Support PoE+, IP67, IK10 • Mobile Software: iCMOB, gCMOB • CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro 3. Specification of CCTC Camera 4MP Dual-Light Bullet Camera Specifications Resolution: 4MP (2560 × 1440) up to 25/30 fps Image Sensor: 1/2.9" or 1/3" Progressive Scan CMOS Lens: 3.6mm or 2.8mm fixed lens Night Vision / Dual Light: Infrared (IR) range up to 30 meters and Warm/White Light range up to 30 meters for full-Color night vision Audio: Built-in microphone for audio recording Video Compression: H.265, H.264, and MJPEG support Ingress Protection: Weatherproof IP67 rating Power Supply: Power over Ethernet (PoE) or 12V DC

Accessories 8-Channel NVR Specifications IP Camera Input: Supports up to 8 channels Decoding / Compression: H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264 Bandwidth: Max 80 Mbps incoming/network bandwidth Display Output: Simultaneous HDMI and VGA output (up to 1080P resolution) Storage: Supports 1 SATA HDD interface (expandable up to 8TB or 10TB depending on the specific model brand like CP Plus or Hikvision) Network & Protocols: RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet interface, ONVIF compliance Remote Access: Mobile apps for iOS and Android (e.g., i-Pro, Hik-Connect, iCMOB) List of accessories - i. Bullet Camera- 02 Nos ii. 1TB hard disc-01 iii. NVR 8 Channel 4k- 01 iv. POE Switch – 01 v. 4U loaded cabinet- 01 vi. Cat 6 cable- 100 mtr Note:- Bidder must quote their rates including material, labour charges, fixation charges (Installation) of PTZ Camera and CCTV camera .
